articles.summary: As the industry leader in wake surfing technology, Malibu Boats has set the standard with our patented, world-famous Surf Gate system. While Surf Gate is part of our comprehensive integrated surf platform - which includes Power Wedge® III, Hard Tank Ballast, Surf Band, and the intuitive Malibu Command Center - it remains our most recognized innovation. This article explores what makes Surf Gate the benchmark in wave-shaping technology and how its integrated design delivers an unmatched on-water experience.
articles.title: Malibu Boats vs. Competitors: How Surf Gate Sets Us Apart

articles.summary: Life is unpredictable, but as Malibu Boats Ambassadors Bill and Giuliana Rancic reminded us, the on-the-water experience together with your loved ones in a Malibu, is a memorable, special experience that you can always count on no matter what life throws our way. Read how the couple's message of positivity and their love for life comes together to create their own Truth On The Water.
articles.title: Bill & Giuliana Rancic's Truth on the Water
